changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Automatic Speech Recognition' from tasks since the paper focuses on Machine Translation (speech-to-text translation). Normalized model names to full descriptive forms. Consolidated outputs to clarify this is speech translation.
Normalized 'Word Error Rate (WER)' to 'WER'. Removed 'CSLS' (cross-domain similarity local scaling) as it's an analysis method rather than an evaluation metric for generated outputs.
Paper does not use LLMs for evaluation. Removed placeholder 'None' values.
Paper does not conduct human evaluations. Removed placeholder 'None' values.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on speech translation (Spanish speech to English text) using multitask learning approaches. The main contribution is using word embeddings as intermediate representations to improve translation quality. Evaluation uses standard MT metrics (BLEU) and speech recognition metrics (WER), with analysis using embedding similarity measures.
